why: Argo, rb and weatherorb need app-owned tokens through one seam, and literal hex has five hand copies (share palette, webmanifest, theme-color metas, SURFACE.bg, email): one generated JSON source replaces them.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/tokens-css.ts (+ test) and src/tokens/emit-json.ts (new, + test). Needs v3-st-5-chart-vars (chart-N and seq-N values). check-tokens and zone-a are v3-tok-t4a-names'.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/tokens-visual.md section 3.8 (--extra), section 4 (flags, the --format json line); docs/v3/concepts/static-framework-free.md section 3 row 4, section 4.2, amendment A1 (section 10).
exemplar: src/cli/tokens-css.ts (2.x flag parsing, emitGeneratedCss --check) and its test; src/tokens/emit-fallback.ts from v3-st-1-emitter (config in, deterministic string out).
change: 1) Flags: --accent --neutral --vibrancy --selector --extra <file> --format css|json --out --check. Each 2.x flag (--only --selector-attribute --selector-class --light-class --dark-value --light-value --default-scheme --media-fallback) exits 1 naming --selector. No --radius/--density/--brightness. 2) --extra src/basalt.tokens.ts (import-free default export { series, vars }, loaded under Bun) emits --vx-<group>-<key> pairs per scheme, vars once on :root, a sibling .d.ts augmenting BasaltRegister; --check is byte-exact on both. Exit 1 on a group colliding with a package name, or a vars value reading a --vx-* outside package names plus file names (message names the nearest valid name). 3) emitJson(config) returns { $generated, $provenance, contract: 3, schemes: { light: { <role>: '#hex' }, dark: {...} } }: the opaque roles of tokens-visual 3.2 plus chart-N and seq-N read from src/tokens/chart-vars, values from the same resolved table the CSS emit reads (hctToHex), fixed key order so two runs are byte-equal. Alpha mixes (hairline, hover, selected, scrim, -tint) are ABSENT, not flattened (static-framework-free section 3 row 4 wins). --format json calls it; --check is byte-exact. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none. Test: tokens-css.test.ts, emit-json.test.ts.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
acceptance: bun test packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/tokens-css.test.ts passes, with a case per removed 2.x flag exiting 1
--extra emits per-scheme pairs, vars once on :root and a .d.ts; one changed byte in either file makes --check exit 1
A colliding group exits 1; --vx-good-solid exits 1 with --vx-good in the message

bun test packages/basalt-ui/src/tokens/emit-json.test.ts passes: every role and scheme equals the CSS emit colour, chart-1..5 and seq-1..5 included; two emits are byte-equal; another accent changes brand, brand-fill and on-brand only
No role named hairline, hover, selected, scrim or ending in -tint is in the JSON
out_of_scope: Radius, density, brightness flags; check-tokens and zone-a (v3-tok-t4a-names); stylelint preset; Tailwind bridge; migration rows; consumers' manifests.
